slug.description: Edge type slug. Must match the manifest key.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this edge represents.

sources.description: TAP entity type slugs allowed as edge source. Omit for wildcard.

targets.description: TAP entity type slugs allowed as edge target. Omit for wildcard.

property_schema.description: JSON Schema for structured edge properties.

default_dimensions.description: Dimensions applied to edges of this type on creation.

internal_only.description: The type is bookkeeping that only subsystem code writes (req-grid-edge-internal): the generic edge verbs and GRIFT import refuse it, and GRIFT export leaves it out. Defaults to false.

identity.description: How a relationship of this type is found again (req-grid-edge-identity-declaration). Exactly one of discriminators (an empty array is the plain key: type, source and target) or keyless. Optional while declarations roll out; a ref-addressed edge of a type without one is refused at import (req-grid-edge-identity-6).

discriminators.description: The properties that, beside the type and the two endpoints, tell one relationship of this type from another. A property belongs here only if two edges that differ in it can be true at the same time. Empty for the plain key.

path.description: A place inside the edge's properties, in the natural-key path grammar: "scope", or "rule.type" for a nested key. Must resolve through property_schema.

description.description: For a human and a robot: what the value is, how it is set, and why it is in the key.

keyless.description: The type observes no source relationship, so nothing finds an edge of it again: a re-sent identical edge fails its batch (req-grid-edge-identity-5).

reason.description: Why the type has no key, for a reader judging whether that is still right.
